parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: DBNode
parameters.description: The information about the nodes to upgrade or add.

sub_parameters.name: TargetClass
sub_parameters.description:
The specifications of the node to upgrade or add.

> - When you add a node, the node specifications must be the same as the specifications of the existing nodes.
>
> - For more information about the specifications of existing cluster nodes, see [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~).

sub_parameters.name: ZoneId
sub_parameters.description: The zone for the new node. The zone must be the same as the zone of the existing nodes.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description: The modification type. The value is fixed to **TempUpgrade**.

parameters.name: OperationType
parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:

- **Modify**: temporary upgrade

- **Add**: temporarily add a node

parameters.name: RestoreTime
parameters.description:
The time to revert the temporary upgrade. The format is YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.

> The revert time must be at least 1 hour later than the current time. It must also be at least 1 day before the cluster expires.
